name: Lava Dungeon
summary:
**Every run carves a new dungeon.**

You start in a lava cavern - your camp. Spend what you brought back, step through a gate, and the dungeon builds itself around you. Kill the Warden and a portal opens. Die, and a quarter of your coins stays in the dark.

# 🔥 A dungeon that rebuilds itself

Three tiers - lava, snow, poison - up to 152 metres a side, 7 to 29 rooms. Generated from a seed, checked so the way to the boss always works.
